questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

He does not trust anybody.

options.text: Anybody is not to be trusted by him.
Anybody is trusted not by him.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Nobody is trusted by him"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in a negative and **active voice.** and it needs to be changed to **passive voice**.
 
• The **passive voice** is used to express interest in the subject of an action rather than the subject or object that actually performs it.
 
• The** rule for structuring** the sentence of **passive voice** is :
 
 
• The object will be changed into the **subject**.
 
• "Does not" will be changed into **"is"**.
 
• And the main verb will be used in **past participle form**.
 
 
 
• Here the object is **"anybody"**.But as it is in **negative form**, we should use nobody as the **subject of passive voice** and the verb will be in **past participle form.**

So the answer will be **Nobody is trusted by him**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see another example of **passive voice**.
 
• You have an **active voice** when the actor (and the actor can be a person or an object) appears **before the action** in a sentence.
 
• The **passive voice** is used to express interest in the subject of **an action** rather than the **subject or object** that actually performs it.
 
• **Example: **I took the pen. **(Active voice)**
 
 
• The pen was taken by me. **(Passive voice)**

questions.question: If the areas of three adjacent faces of a cuboidal box are 729 cm², 529 cm², and 289 cm² respectively, then find the volume of the box.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Areas of 3 adjacent faces, 

729 cm2, 529 cm2, and 289 cm2 

**Concept Used:**

Area of single cuboidal face = l × b,

Volume of Cuboid = l × b × h 

where l is the length, b is the breadth, and h is the height.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/897d8480061989755bf70e42825377ebcb01c40dd61b9ba637715095ecd4a0af.png] 

According to the question, 

 l × b = 729

b × h = 529

h × l = 289

Multiplying all three results, we will get

⇒ l × b × b × h × h × l = 729 × 529 × 289 

⇒ l² × b² × h² = 729 × 529 × 289 

Taking square root on both sides, 

⇒ l × b × h = {sqrt{729 × 529 × 289}} 

⇒ l × b × h = 10,557

**∴ The volume of a cuboid is 10,557 cm³. **

Distance = [(Product of speeds) ÷ (Difference of speeds)] × Time Difference

Distance = [(30 × 14) ÷ (30 − 14)] × 4

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed downstream = 22 + 8 = 30 km/h

⇒ Speed upstream = 22 − 8 = 14 km/h

Relative Speeds in Water

If the boat's speed is u and the stream's speed is v, then Downstream Speed = u + v, and Upstream Speed = u − v.

Finding Speeds from Upstream & Downstream

Boat's speed in still water = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2. Stream's speed = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.

questions.question: The reflection on a bathroom mirror, the lake, and the glare on a pair of glasses are caused by which type of reflection?

__
 
• The reflection on a bathroom mirror, the lake, and the glare on a pair of glasses are caused by **Specular reflection.**
 
• **Specular reflection** reflects all light which arrives from a given direction at the same angle, whereas diffuse reflection reflects light in a broad range of directions.
 
• The distinction may be illustrated with surfaces coated with **glossy paint and matte paint**.
 
• Measurement of **specular reflection** is performed with normal or varying incidence reflection spectrophotometers (reflectometer) using a scanning variable-wavelength light source.
 
• Lower quality measurements using a **glossmeter** quantify the glossy appearance of a surface in gloss units.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Multiple reflection **of light is the reflection of light back and forth several times between reflecting surfaces.
 
• **Glossy surfaces** are actually specular surfaces with micro surfaces at angles to surface plane. These micro surfaces reflect light not only specularly but also diffusely, giving the surface a glossy appearance.
 
• **Diffuse reflection** is the reflection of light or other waves or particles from a surface such that a ray incident on the surface is scattered at many angles rather than at just one angle as in the case of specular reflection.
